hints.text: Compute initial earnings from applying the default unmodified strategy vector.

hints.title: Window Gain Tracking
hints.text: Express the impact of setting the strategy to 1 across a k-length window as a sliding difference.

hints.title: Sliding Differential
hints.text: Add the incoming element difference and drop the exiting window element in constant time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: List[int], strategy: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(prices)
        # Base profit without modifying strategy
        base_profit = sum(p * s for p, s in zip(prices, strategy))
        
        # We can change strategy in one window of size k to all 1s (always buy or sell to maximize)
        # Difference in window: sum(p * (1 - s))
        cur_gain = sum(prices[i] * (1 - strategy[i]) for i in range(min(k, n)))
        max_gain = max(0, cur_gain)
        
        for i in range(k, n):
            cur_gain += prices[i] * (1 - strategy[i])
            cur_gain -= prices[i - k] * (1 - strategy[i - k])
            max_gain = max(max_gain, cur_gain)
            
        return base_profit + max_gain
```

complexity.notes: Single pass baseline sum followed by a sliding window of size k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing window sum from scratch for each position takes O(N * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses scalar variables for running sums with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the sliding window pattern to compute maximum additive delta.
